name: mermaid-view
description: A Claude Code mod: a browser editor for Mermaid diagrams, those of Claude's answers and those in your project's Markdown documents and .mmd files. Zoom, minimap, Monaco source editing linked to the diagram, themes, a library, git history and export; edits go back to Claude

dataDir.title: Data folder
dataDir.description: Where pages, edits and their git history are kept (~ is your home folder).

keepDays.title: Keep unedited pages (days)
keepDays.description: Pages neither edited nor pinned are removed after this many days; 0 keeps them all.

openFiles.title: Open files Claude writes
openFiles.description: When Claude writes a project document or .mmd file that holds Mermaid diagrams, open it in the editor (once per file per session).

reuseTab.title: Show new diagrams in the open tab
reuseTab.description: Show a new answer's diagrams, or a project file Claude writes, in the editor tab already open instead of opening a new tab. A tab with edits in progress offers the diagram instead of switching; a tab hidden and unused for 30 minutes is passed over.
